title: Exprimer la fréquence, la quantité et l'insistance
summary: Distinguish chaque/tous les, quelques/un peu de/peu de and the main uses of même.
objectives: Express repeated intervals with chaque or tous les.
Choose a quantity expression for countable or mass nouns.
Distinguish même as same, self, very/exact and even.

sources.label: University of Texas: même and adjective position
B1 public topic index (coverage reference only)

sections.title: Every day is not every two days
paragraphs: Chaque is followed by a singular noun: chaque jour, chaque semaine. Tous les is used with a masculine plural and toutes les with a feminine plural: tous les jours, toutes les semaines. These can describe the same frequency as chaque + singular.

To describe a repeating interval of more than one unit, use tous les/toutes les + number + plural unit: tous les deux jours, every two days. Toutes les deux semaines means every two weeks, not twice a week. Twice a week is deux fois par semaine.
points: Vocabulary: un jour (masculine), a day; une semaine (feminine), a week; une heure (feminine), an hour.
Do not add an article after chaque.

examples.english: I check the registrations every morning.

examples.french: Le groupe se réunit **toutes les deux semaines**.
examples.english: The group meets every two weeks.
examples.note: An interval of two weeks, not two meetings in one week.

examples.french: Le bus passe **tous les quarts d'heure**.
examples.english: The bus comes every quarter of an hour.
examples.note: Quart is masculine; the plural noun phrase takes tous les.

mistakes.avoid: Chaque semaines, nous faisons le point.
mistakes.prefer: Chaque semaine, nous faisons le point.

sections.title: A few, a little and not much
paragraphs: Quelques + plural count noun means a few or some: quelques questions. Un peu de + a mass noun means a little: un peu de temps. Peu de + a plural count noun means few, and peu de + a mass noun means little/not much. The difference is often an attitude to sufficiency: un peu de temps presents an amount available, while peu de temps stresses scarcity.

Quelque in the singular can mean some or a certain amount of with a singular noun in expressions such as quelque temps, some time, or quelque difficulté, some difficulty. It is not the usual everyday substitute for a bit of water: use un peu d'eau. Quelques does not promise exactly two; English a couple can be more exact than the French phrase.
points: Vocabulary: une question (feminine), a question; le temps (masculine), time; l'eau (feminine), water.
De elides before a vowel: peu d'idées, un peu d'eau.

examples.english: There are a few questions left to resolve.

examples.french: Nous avons **un peu de temps**, mais **peu d'argent**.
examples.english: We have a little time, but not much money.
examples.note: The first amount is available; the second is presented as limited.

examples.english: I will stay here for some time.
examples.note: Singular quelque in a common time expression.

mistakes.why: A mass amount of water uses un peu de, with elision, rather than plural quelques.

sections.title: Même: identify what is being emphasized
paragraphs: Before a noun with a determiner, même means same and agrees in number: le même trajet, les mêmes questions. After a noun, it can mean the very, exact or precise thing: le jour même, that very day; à l'endroit même, at the exact spot. In an emphatic phrase such as la patience même, it means patience itself. It still agrees when it is an adjective attached to a plural noun.

Attached to a stressed pronoun with a hyphen, même emphasizes self: moi-même, toi-même, lui-même, elle-même, soi-même, nous-mêmes, vous-mêmes, eux-mêmes, elles-mêmes. With polite vous addressing one person, use vous-même. This emphasis is not a replacement for a reflexive object pronoun: elle se prépare elle-même contains both.

As an adverb, même means even and stays unchanged: même les enfants, even the children; ils ont même proposé leur aide, they even offered help. Position shows what is surprising. Do not add s just because an adverbial même sits before a plural noun.
points: Exactness after a noun and even before a group are different jobs, not interchangeable translations.
The simple forms même/mêmes do not change for gender.

examples.note: Adjective même agrees with plural horaires.
Post-noun même emphasizes the exact day.

examples.french: C'est ici, à l'endroit **même** où nous nous sommes rencontrés.
examples.english: It is here, at the very spot where we met.
This activity leader is patience itself.

examples.note: The subject did it personally; use a hyphen and plural s.
Adverbial même stays singular before a plural group.

practice.prompt: Supply chaque or tous les: ___ jour, elle ouvre le local.
Supply tous les or toutes les: une réunion ___ trois semaines.
Choose quelques or un peu de: Il reste ___ pain.
practice.explanation: Pain is treated as a mass amount.

practice.prompt: Supply même with the correct form: Nous avons les ___ idées.
practice.explanation: Same as an adjective agrees with plural idées.

practice.prompt: Write every two days using tous, les, deux and jours.
practice.explanation: This expresses one event per two-day interval.

practice.prompt: Choose the expression meaning twice a week, not every two weeks.
practice.explanation: Two occurrences within one week differs from a two-week interval.

practice.prompt: Supply quelques or un peu de: Nous avons ___ propositions.
Choose the phrase emphasizing a shortage of time.
practice.explanation: Peu de stresses limited quantity, unlike the more positive un peu de.

practice.prompt: Supply quelque or quelques: Nous attendrons encore ___ temps.
practice.explanation: Quelque temps is a singular expression meaning some time.

practice.prompt: Supply même or mêmes to mean even: ___ les voisins sont venus.
practice.explanation: Adverbial even does not agree with voisins.

practice.prompt: Supply the emphatic pronoun meaning ourselves: Nous l'avons construit ___.
practice.explanation: Attach mêmes to plural nous with a hyphen.

practice.prompt: Supply the single word emphasizing that exact evening: Elle est repartie le soir ___.
practice.explanation: Post-noun même means that very evening.

practice.prompt: Supply the emphatic pronoun for one woman addressed politely: Vous l'avez vérifié ___.
practice.explanation: Polite singular vous takes singular même.

practice.prompt: Complete the emphatic phrase meaning kindness itself: Elle est la gentillesse ___.
practice.explanation: Post-noun même can intensify an abstract quality as itself.

practice.prompt: Supply the complete quantity phrase meaning few before idées: Il a ___ idées. Use peu.
practice.explanation: Peu de before a vowel becomes peu d'.

practice.prompt: Supply même in the phrase meaning at the exact spot: à l'endroit ___ où le chemin commence.
practice.explanation: Post-noun même emphasizes the precise location.

production_task.prompt: Explain your association's routine and resources. State a recurring interval, a few available items, a limited resource, something the same for everyone and one surprising fact using even.
production_task.model_answer: Nous nous réunissons toutes les deux semaines. Nous avons quelques outils et un peu de matériel, mais peu d'argent. Tous les membres suivent les mêmes consignes. Même les nouveaux participants peuvent proposer une activité. Nous préparons les affiches nous-mêmes.
production_task.translation: We meet every two weeks. We have a few tools and a little equipment, but not much money. All members follow the same instructions. Even new participants can propose an activity. We prepare the posters ourselves.
rubric: Do not confuse an interval with a number of meetings per week.
Choose quantity expressions according to countable or mass meaning.
Agree adjective mêmes but not adverb même.
Use the emphatic pronoun with a hyphen if included.
